items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: I took a couple lessons from Johnny, but I didn't like it.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with them? No. Johnny played Trump. Johnny played Trump. Johnny played Trump. I took a couple lessons from Johnny, but I didn't like it. I figured it would come out of my head. He was better than sitting down with music. Yeah. Yeah. He's one of our old neighbors, Johnny Deetra. Yeah, Johnny Deetra. Is that right? That's right. Wonderful people. An old man used to tell me, you're going to regret it. You're going to regret it. I said, no, I ain't. I said, what comes out that head is good, and it's…
